summary: Iter25 verifies (1) recalibrated AI tip ratings (Über 1.5 <9, cap 9.5, only safe markets 9.0-9.5), (2) real bookmaker odds integration with fallback (mix of 'Echte Buchmacher-Quote' and estimated odds in AI analyses), (3) 4 Systems bundles (lock/value/risk/gamble) with numeric selection odds and correct computed total_odds, (4) counts endpoint contains {ai,ai_total,members,live,systems,smart} all int, (5) Smart tips still present (7) and not touched by settle engine, (6) POST /api/admin/smart/run returns {posted,matches,candidates}, (7) POST /api/admin/autotips/reset returns {deleted:53, forebet:{posted:9}, predictz:{posted:15}} in 35s, (8) FRONTEND Spanish language switcher (data-testid='lang-es') works: hero H1 'Publícalo. Puntúalo. Cóbralo.', quick-view buttons show 'Ver Picks de IA/Sistemas de IA/Smart Bets/Picks de Miembros/Picks en Vivo', bell settings show 'Ajustes de Alertas' with 5 area toggles (Picks de IA, Sistemas, Smart Bets, Picks de Miembros, Picks en Vivo), no raw i18n keys leaked, (9) Splash /splash-es.png HTTP 200 (1.2MB) and renders as SplashScreen bg when localStorage tj_lang='es' on reload, (10) Language switching en→de→es→el preserves all 5 quick-view buttons and Systems/Smart/AI tabs continue to render correctly.

The frontend correctly renders the empty state. Not a regression bug — data state.
critical_code_review_comments: AI rating cap logic in _forebet_candidates/_predictz_candidates is enforced end-to-end: no 'Über 1.5 Tore' pick has rating>=9 in live data; only 'Über 0.5', 'DNB' and similar safe markets reach 9.0-9.5. Predictz picks correctly capped ≤8.0.

Real-odds integration is well-designed: analysis distinguishes 'Echte Buchmacher-Quote' vs fallback estimates, so users can see provenance. Partial coverage (some fixtures without odds) is handled gracefully with fallback — no 500s observed across pending/won/lost filters.

Systems endpoint returns clean numeric selection.odds and computed total_odds that matches the product of selection odds within 5% (float rounding). All 4 bundle types (lock/value/risk/gamble) present with distinct copy and risk tags.

Smart tips are correctly source-isolated: source='smart' filter returns only smart, and settle_pending_tips does not touch them (7 smart tips remained after autotips/reset ran and deleted 53 hq-auto tips).

Admin auth is correctly enforced on /api/admin/smart/run (401/403 without token). Admin /api/admin/autotips/reset accepts credentials in body and completes with structured response — good ergonomics for the admin panel.

i18n: Spanish 'es' block is complete for hero + nav.view* + bell.area.* — no missing keys observed on the home screen after switching. Splash localization uses SPLASH_BY_LANG.es→/splash-es.png (1.2MB, HTTP 200).
